newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA denies rumours of afternoon rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA denies rumours of afternoon rate cut.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said there was no foundation to market rumours the bank would announce a cut in official interest rates this afternoon.
"There is no foundation to the rumour," an RBA spokesman told Reuters.
Traders said there had been some speculation that the RBA would announce a rate cut at its normal time slot of 9.30 a.m., when it conducts money market operations.
This system of announcing changes in policy at the morning operation has been in place since 1990.
In the event, the bank remained silent. But then the rumour developed into a new version which had the bank announcing a cut at 4.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) as part of a change in its procedures.
